terminology.number_of_recurrent_zones: unbounded; one or many disconnected zones are allowed
terminology.boundary: a spatial zone with elevated within-species flower-colour discontinuity intensity
terminology.common_boundary_architecture: a non-uniform spatial propensity for colour discontinuities that is recoverable in independently held-out species, regardless of how many disconnected zones compose the field
terminology.global_commonness: common-boundary architecture that is not attributable to a small set of species, families, or one geographic region
terminology.universal_tendency: reserved for a stronger process-level claim: positive recurrence is expected across adequately sampled independent geographic/taxonomic strata; identical boundary coordinates are not required

level_1_recurrent_spatial_concentration.meaning: colour-discontinuity intensity is more spatially concentrated than the frozen within-species colour-permutation null
level_1_recurrent_spatial_concentration.note: multiple peaks or disconnected zones are fully compatible with this level

level_2_common_across_species.meaning: a field estimated from one set of species predicts the spatial distribution of colour discontinuity in species that were not used to estimate that field

level_3_globally_common.meaning: level 2 persists after taxonomic and geographic blocking and is not driven by one lineage or one region
required_validation: family-blocked or lineage-blocked cross-prediction where taxonomy permits
region/realm-stratified recurrence summaries with no dominant single-region explanation

level_4_universal_tendency.meaning: the recurrence-generating process is expected to be positive in new adequately sampled strata
level_4_universal_tendency.required_validation: hierarchical stratum-level effect with positive overall effect and a prediction interval excluding zero, plus no adequately powered stratum with a reproducible sign reversal

prospective_species_disjoint_test.purpose: decide level_2_common_across_species without assuming one boundary or one connected zone

partition.species_unit: eligible species from the frozen measured pool

field_construction.retain_primary_colour_distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits on four-group colour vector

cross_prediction_statistic.per_fold: opportunity-weighted correlation between training-species and held-out-species consensus discontinuity fields over jointly evaluable cells
cross_prediction_statistic.global_statistic: median of the five held-out fold correlations
cross_prediction_statistic.interpretation: positive values mean that high-discontinuity places learned from one set of species recur in different species

null.unit: complete four-group colour vectors permuted within species
null.monte_carlo_p: (1 + count(null global statistic >= observed global statistic)) / 1000

common_across_species_supported_if: at least four of five held-out fold correlations are > 0
claim_rule.failure_of_rule: do not claim common-across-species architecture; retain only lower-level recurrence/robustness claims already supported

zone_reporting_after_commonness.connected_components_allowed: any positive integer determined by the frozen field/threshold procedure
zone_reporting_after_commonness.preferred_language: globally recurrent flower-colour transition zones or common multi-zone boundary architecture
avoid_language: the same boundary is crossed by every species
